analysis.summary: Framed presentation version of the ocean canvas with decorative borders. Same four-zone vertical composition (surface, reef, kelp, abyss) but with added frame elements and a purple-violet color treatment that gives it a more stylized, artistic appearance suitable for display purposes.

frames.text: Framed version of the four-zone ocean canvas with visible border elements on edges. Shows sunlit surface, purple-tinted coral reef, kelp forest, and abyss zones stacked vertically. The frame adds a presentation/display quality to the composition.

Mid-animation with frame borders visible. Bubbles rise through surface waters, reef shows active fish movement among pink-purple corals, kelp forest has darker purple-blue tones. Overall violet color cast throughout the framed composition.

Final frame showing complete ocean journey with purple-violet color treatment. Surface light streams down, dense coral gardens visible, kelp rendered in darker tones, pink jellyfish glows in the abyss. Frame borders clearly visible on sides.
